hooks.command: cargo run --quiet -- memory tick --passive "Experience: Executed tool '$TOOL' with status '$STATUS'" 2>/dev/null
echo '== Legend Project Context =='; cargo run --quiet -- project ls 2>/dev/null || echo 'Project state not found'; echo '== Legend Memory =='; cargo run --quiet -- memory start --compact 2>/dev/null

changed=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -5); if [ -n "$changed" ]; then count=$(echo "$changed" | wc -l); echo "Legend: $count file(s) changed."; echo "Remember to tick: cargo run --quiet -- memory tick 'summary of work'"; fi
cargo run --quiet -- memory tick --passive "Experience: Completed an agent turn. Current goal state updated." 2>/dev/null
